mode: Built-in image_gen.imagegen; one call per requested asset, eight total planned. No CLI/API fallback.

sources.principle: Residentially scaled comfort, tactile material layering, curated contemporary art, privacy and intimacy; adapted to a compact Shanghai flat rather than reproducing hotel spaces.
Mansion/manor framing interpreted as a private collected residence.

intended_invariants: Exact original camera, 3:2 frame, structure, doors, windows, ceiling planes, columns and city views. Secondary living image supplies style only.

assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: photoreal architectural interior image, the living-room view of a coherent eight-room 75.1-square-metre Shanghai two-bedroom apartment concept named 藏品公馆 (do not render this name or any text).
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and the absolute authority for room geometry, camera and composition. Redesign only surface finishes, furniture, decorative objects and luminaires. Keep the image's exact 3:2 landscape framing, fixed viewpoint, lens perspective, scale and room proportions. Preserve every wall and ceiling plane, the complete original tray ceiling and beams, every column, door, doorway, glazed opening, frame, threshold, and all visible adjoining-room relationships at exactly the same position and dimensions. Keep the left television in place. This combined living-and-dining space is only 21.4 sqm: no enlargement, no new openings, no hotel lobby.
Primary request: create an elegant contemporary collected private residence, informed by Tony Chi's warm residential-estate, artful comfort and privacy principles associated with Rosewood Hong Kong, while creating a new compact domestic design, never copying a hotel interior.
Create a materially rich but luminous composition: pale creamy hand-finished plaster on the sofa wall and rear dining wall, tactile dark walnut and warm tobacco veneer for the television console, narrow bookcase, rear sideboard and existing door/column cladding. Fine understated satin bronze trim and handles. Same floor geometry in softly honed pale warm-grey stone with subtle dark veining, not shiny gold-beige marble.
Replace the bulky brown sofa at exactly its current position and overall footprint with a beautifully tailored slim-profile oxblood/burgundy nappa-leather sofa, low clean arms, subtle supple leather grain, precise seams, comfortable cushions, slender dark bronze feet. Add only two restrained ivory/chocolate pillows. Replace the coarse tan rug with a luxurious very densely woven fine wool-silk rug in layered warm ivory, mushroom and charcoal ink-tonal abstract weave: subtle fine pattern, medallionless, close-cut fine pile, soft silk sheen. It must NOT look like jute, sisal, rope, chunky boucle or coarse loops; no shag.
Replace the heavy coffee-table block with a visually thin warm-grey natural-stone top with elegant dark irregular veining, softened rectangular corners, supported by four fine dark-bronze metal legs with open air beneath. Same coffee-table position and footprint; on it one small sculptural bronze abstract object and a restrained closed art book, no branch vase.
Exactly ONE contemporary abstract artwork in the whole view: one refined large canvas above the sofa, in tones of warm chalk, muted oxblood and charcoal with quiet painterly gestural shapes in a thin bronze frame. Remove the old landscape artwork on the rear dining wall and leave beautiful pale plaster there. No literal landscapes, no ornate antique frames. Rear dining table and four chairs stay in their existing positions and compact dimensions: refined dark walnut table, walnut frames with tobacco fine-leather upholstered chair seats/backs. Modest dark-bronze and opal pendant at existing junction. Rear sideboard gets a discreet warm parchment-shaded bronze table lamp and a single small ceramic bowl. Keep bookshelves sparse and carefully selected.
Luminous natural daylight matching the original direction of window light and shadow, lifted soft natural bounce, true pale cream walls, rich warm-red leather, deep warm wood and small bronze glints. Warm lamps only as soft accents, not amber dusk color grading. High-end editorial architectural photography, physically plausible reflections, exceptional leather, veneer, stone and textile microtexture. Spatially modest, calm, private and liveable.
Avoid: changed geometry or perspective, new or moved doors/windows/columns, larger rooms, hotel-lobby grandeur, chandelier spectacle, tacky gold, antiques clutter, saturated blue, dark gloomy grading, rustic coarse rug, giant accessories, people, text, signs, logos, watermarks, UI. Output one clean image, native 3:2 landscape resolution, ideally 1536x1024, no border.

qa.assessment: Accepted visual asset. Same viewpoint and architectural openings; requested oxblood sofa, dense fine patterned rug, thin veined stone table, bronze object and one abstract artwork are present.
deviations: Common-area flooring remains warm taupe-grey rather than a distinctly cooler pale grey.
